description: Disk fills, writes start failing. Distinctive because the errors surface in unrelated subsystems at once.

timeline.message: failed to write segment 00041: No space left on device
OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device
checkpoint flush aborted, retaining in-memory buffer
heap usage climbing: 2.1GB of 2.5GB, buffer not draining

ground_truth.root_cause: The volume backing /var/lib/archiver is full at 98%, so every segment write fails with ENOSPC. The rising heap is a consequence: undrained checkpoint buffers are retained in memory because they cannot be flushed to disk.
must_not_conclude: out of memory is the root cause
ground_truth.distractor_note: A weak RCA reads the climbing heap as a memory leak. The heap is downstream of the disk.
